domain-information: A Intake Coordinator receives a surrendered animal and creates an intake record for the shelter database.
A Intake Coordinator assigns the animal to an available caretaker for initial settling.
A Intake Coordinator forwards medical concerns to the veterinary technician after intake evaluation.
A Animal Caretaker provides daily feeding according to the care plan created by the veterinary technician.
A Animal Caretaker notes changes in an animal’s behavior in the observation log.
A Animal Caretaker requests medical review when an animal shows signs of stress or illness.
A Veterinary Technician performs a health assessment and updates the animal’s medical profile.
A Veterinary Technician prescribes a treatment routine and instructs the caretaker on how to follow it.
A Adoption Counselor reviews the animal’s profile to prepare adoption recommendations for adopters.
A Adoption Counselor schedules visits from adopters.
A Adoption Counselor registers an adoption of an animal by an adopter.

associations.description: Intake Coordinator registers and records Animal.

Intake Coordinator assigns Animal to Animal Caretaker.
Intake Coordinator forwards Medical Review Request to Veterinary Technician.
Animal Caretaker performs Feeding for Animal.
Animal Caretaker follows Care Plan for Animal.
Feeding provides food to Animal.
Animal Caretaker updates Observation Log for Animal.
Animal Caretaker submits Medical Review Request to Intake Coordinator.
Medical Review Request notifies Intake Coordinator.
Veterinary Technician performs Health Assessment on Animal.
Health Assessment updates Animal status.
Veterinary Technician updates Medical Profile for Animal.
Veterinary Technician creates Care Plan for Animal.
Adoption Counselor evaluates Animal for adoption.
Adoption Counselor prepares Adoption Recommendation for Adopter.
Adoption Recommendation informs Adopter.
Adopter schedules Visit with Adoption Counselor.
Adoption Counselor conducts Visit with Adopter.
Adopter completes Adoption of Animal.
